status: frozen preregistration v2 before opening reserved scenes; v1 superseded after blocked review
scope: SIMULATED reserved holdout validation; not physical or deployment validation
purpose: Evaluate the immutable D004 five-view candidate with the frozen D003 estimator on exactly 12 newly generated, previously unscored simulator scenes.
stop_boundary: No capture, reconstruction, truth evaluation, score, result, or scene removal before independent pre-open release.

candidate.immutability: Exactly the D004 candidate coordinates and zero orientation, with only fresh R007 sequence numbers; no pose, estimator, threshold, scene, or gate changes after opening.

acquisition.frame_format: 704-byte BFLD v2.1, 8x8, geometry version 3, 4 m range, valid CRC
acquisition.canonical_order: Protocol scene order, then candidate capture order, ordinals 1 through 60.
acquisition.command_identity: Each precommitted entry contains a unique command_id, complete scene parameters, view_id, sequence, pose, exact argv, and expected output path.
acquisition.provenance_binding: Capture executes each canonical entry in order, atomically commits that command's stdout only to its precommitted path, and records command digest, stdout/frame SHA-256, and decoded header under the same command_id.
acquisition.validation: Recompute the full plan from this protocol and reject any permutation, rename, scene reassignment, path or command mismatch, duplicate command ID/path/hash, missing entry, extra entry, or unexpected file.

primary_gate.name: all_12_total_eligible_and_each_within_5pct
primary_gate.partial_policy: Any partial, unavailable, invalid, or otherwise ineligible scene fails the entire gate; unsupported cells are never zero-filled.
primary_gate.no_aggregate_substitution: Mean, median, pooled, or family-level performance cannot replace every-scene passage.

reported: accepted-return hull and estimator rejection diagnostics
raw and merged points, merge conflicts, and triangle counts
secondary_diagnostics.gate_effect: None. Spatial error and cancellation are mandatory disclosures and cannot alter, rescue, or tighten the preregistered primary gate.

truth_boundary.truth_import: Only inside the scoring runner evaluator function, after all 12 truth-free reconstructions have completed.

interpretation_limits: R007 is a reserved simulation holdout, not evidence of physical sensor accuracy, hardware reliability, or deployment readiness.
The simulator uses ideal center rays with deterministic dropout and simplified beam geometry; it omits finite-zone optics, noise, multipath, calibration drift, and many material effects.
D003 global Delaunay interpolation can bridge discontinuities or occluded gaps; low total error can coexist with large spatial error and cancellation.
The 12 simulator scenes are fixed parametric variants from five supported shape families, not independent physical replications or a complete operating envelope.
